evidence_contract.p01_actual_or_model: For every named row record case/input, pre-test prediction, falsifier, action/command, contract expectation, actual observation or null with block reason, environment, evidence class, locator, mechanism and limit.
evidence_contract.prediction_falsifiers: prediction_limit contains separate falsifiers for both predictions before execution.
p01_required_rows: valid finite input and happy path
pre-aborted signal rejection before Worker creation
request ID retirement or reuse policy
final pending, listener and worker ownership
evidence_contract.p02_separate_classification: Record source prediction, model trace and native Service Worker observation independently in p02_control_state and p02_limit. Registered, active, ready and controlled are distinct states.
evidence_contract.gemini: Actual response remains null for PENDING or BLOCKED. A synthetic sample supports practice only and is never an actual Gemini exchange.
evidence_contract.real_browser_measurement: Do not infer responsiveness timing from a fake Worker trace or source alone.
